verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Scrape turns a page into Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request, and the llms.txt probe repeats that webpages can be scraped into HTML. The TypeScript and Python SDKs document scraping a webpage, so the core single-call HTML scrape is clearly claimed. Missing for 10: confirmation that the HTML returned is raw rather than cleaned or processed, endpoint-level reference detail on the HTML output format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of HTML scraping.
